sloka: वसिष्ठस्तु तदा राममुक्त्वा राजपुरोऺहित: ।अब्रवीद्धर्मसंयुक्तं पुनरेवापरं वच: ॥ २.१११.१॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭhastu tadā rāmamuktvā rājapuroऺhita: ।abravīddharmasaṁyuktaṁ punarevāparaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.111.1॥

translations.english: Vasistha, the family priest, continued to speak to Rama on righteousness.
